articleTitle: Is There a Safest Hormone Therapy for Menopause?
imageHeadline: HRT safety isn't one answer—it depends on timing & type
imageSubtext: Hormone, dose, route, and when you start all change the risk math
pinTitle: Is There a Safest Hormone Therapy for Menopause? What the Research Shows
pinDescription: HRT safety depends on which hormone, what dose, how it's delivered, and when you start—not a single yes or no. Learn how timing, estrogen-alone vs. combined therapy, and transdermal vs. oral routes shift the risk-benefit picture so you can have a more grounded conversation with your provider.
